column1: # P0 compatibility metadata for the shared kind cluster.
# - Questions sharing a mutex key may not appear in the same mock exam.
# - A question whose `breaks` key intersects another question's `requires` key
#   may not appear in the same mock exam.
# - Higher setup_priority values run later, independently of displayed order.
# - Any question whose meta.yaml selects a disposable environment is disabled
#   here. It runs individually through `cka start`, never in the shared form.
# - ts-05 and ts-12 remain disabled until their faults also move to cells.
